params.body:
## What was wrong

`GET /internal/projection/articles/:id` returned any piece by id, drafts included, to whoever held `PROJECTION_TOKEN`, while the manifest beside it lists published posts only. The site never needed more: its webhook removes its copy when the answer is not a published post, and its reconcile asks only for ids the manifest just listed. That reconcile also upserts whatever comes back, so a post unpublished between the manifest and the fetch was written back as a public copy.

## What changes

The read by id answers what the manifest lists, a published post, and 404 for anything else. The site already treats 404 as gone. A draft reaches the site only through a preview link (`/internal/projection/preview/:token`).

## Checked

- `test/projection-endpoints.test.mjs`: a published post is served, a draft and a post taken down answer 404. The new case fails on main.
- The full suite passes apart from `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm` and that is not installed on the workbench.

Independent of the site PR that goes with it; merge in either order.
params.title: The projection read by id serves published posts only
